description: This YAML file defines classes and enums related to WFA Beacon Metrics Responses, including data structures for beacon report elements, measurement reports, and associated enum types.

classes.name: tlvBeaconMetricsResponse
classes.description: Class representing the Beacon Metrics Response TLV with fields for type, length, associated STA MAC, report list length, and a list of measurement reports.

classes.name: cMeasurementReportElement
classes.description: Class representing individual measurement report elements, including report details like measurement token, mode, type, and various measurement parameters.

classes.name: eElementID
classes.description: Enum defining element IDs, currently only ID_MEASUREMENT_REPORT with value 39.

classes.name: eMeasurementType
classes.description: Enum defining measurement types, currently only TYPE_BEACON with value 5.

classes.name: eBeaconReportStatusCode
classes.description: Enum defining status codes for beacon reports, including success, no report, not supported, and unspecified responses.
